idea-plugin.name: Nest Switch
idea-plugin.description: Adds every file of the current NestJS module — controllers, services, providers, DTOs, entities, guards, pipes, specs, and anything sitting in dto/, entities/ and friends — to Navigate > Related Symbol (Ctrl+Alt+Home), grouped by role. The module is the nearest folder that declares a *.module.ts; nested modules stay out of the list. No icons, no editor decorations — only active in projects that depend on @nestjs/*.
